text: On the authority of Aisha, may God be pleased with her, that when the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, went to bed every night, he would bring his palms together and then blow on them, reciting in them: ((Say, He is God, One)) and ((Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of creation)) and ((Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind)), then he would wipe with them as much of his body as he could, starting with them on his head and face, and the front of his body, and he did this three times.
